when: Any repository, head or archive identity gate fails.
The current source cannot establish whether zero is admitted or whether declarations are checked.
Issue inventory remains paginated after the sixth total request or an apparent duplicate is ambiguous within the local inspection cap.
Any accounting, custody or process fault prevents an evidence-bound decision.
BOUNDED_UNRESOLVED.output: Name the exact blocker and unblocking condition without asserting current upstream behavior or duplicate absence.

when_any: Current source rejects or normalizes num_threads=0 before declaration dispatch.
Current zero-thread dispatch still checks every declaration.
A current upstream regression already covers invalid-declaration behavior at num_threads=0.
An existing issue or pull request already reports the same zero-worker declaration-check elision.
NO_GO.output: Record the exact fix, coverage or duplicate and recommend no new issue.

when_all: Current public configuration still admits num_threads=0.
Current dispatch selects a zero-worker path that invokes no declaration checks and can continue to success reporting.
The bounded complete issue/PR inventory finds no existing report or regression for this behavior.
GO.output: Prepare a source-bound minimal regression recommendation and standalone issue draft, but perform no external write.

claim_limits: The local executable fixed pair remains evidence for pinned revision 6ae1f0cd962f081f6c423454c5da729d841236a7 only.
Current-source inspection is not a current binary reproduction and establishes no broader soundness or semantic-authority claim.
Duplicate absence is scoped to the retained repository issue/PR inventory returned within the request bound.
A GO decision recommends human review and separately authorized submission; it is not publication authorization.
